title: CollectionShare
description: Canonical CollectionShare aggregate root (ADR-016). One payer's portion of a Collection. NEVER contains a balance and NEVER references the ledger. Its only money anchor is transfer_id (a pointer to the real settling Transfer, for reconciliation). Settled via its own PaymentIntent (ADR-014).

participant.description: @banza/wallet the share is addressed to, when known. Open contributions may be null until paid.

amount_minor.description: Integer minor units. Never float. (MINIMUM_CONTRIBUTION enforces a per-share floor.)

payment_intent_id.description: PaymentIntent (ADR-014) backing this share; its link/QR derive from it.

transfer_id.description: Real Transfer that settled this share. Set only when status=PAID. Reconciliation anchor.

lifecycle.description: PENDING -> LINK_CREATED -> PAID; PENDING/LINK_CREATED -> EXPIRED|CANCELLED|FAILED. PAID is terminal (no double payment, INV-COLLECTION-006).

invariants: INV-COLLECTION-005: PAID only via a real confirmed Transfer; causation_id of that Transfer == payment_intent_id.
INV-COLLECTION-006: a PAID share is terminal and MUST NOT accept further payment.
_numeric_domain: Integers in a signed or digested BANZA artifact are bounded by the canonicalization in force (BCJ/1: |n| <= 2^53-1, spec/canonicalization.md P2). The bound is declared here so the schema and the canonicalization cannot disagree about what is representable.
